<script>
(function () {
  /* Exposed as otgsConsentConfig, NEVER as window.klaroConfig (MSG-cmo-0011):
     Klaro AUTO-RUNS setup() the moment it detects window.klaroConfig, which
     showed the banner even where D11 says it must not. The `noAutoLoad` flag
     does not help — it is only honoured on the branch where Klaro fetches its
     own config, and setting it makes an explicit setup() a no-op instead.
     So: no auto-detected global, and the gate below inits explicitly.
     Neutral name also keeps "klaro" out of the source (EasyList posture). */
  window.otgsConsentConfig = {
    version: 1,
    elementID: "klaro",
    styling: { theme: ["right", "bottom", "light"] },
    /* D11 geo gate (MSG-cmo-0008/0011, CONSENT-SYNC.md §0): Klaro is inited
       only where the law requires consent, or where the visitor already has a
       stored choice. The footer "Cookie Settings" button lazy-inits on demand,
       so it works from the never-inited state too — it passes the modal flag,
       because a bare show() from that state renders the NOTICE instead of the
       settings modal. */
    cookieExpiresAfterDays: 365,
    /* one consent across wpml.org + app.wpml.org (MSG-cmo-0057 §4): the app reads this
       cookie to pick the tracker mode. Local preview hosts fall back to host-only. */
    cookieDomain: location.hostname.endsWith("wpml.org") ? ".wpml.org" : undefined,
    default: false,
    mustConsent: false,
    acceptAll: true,
    hideDeclineAll: false,
    lang: "en",
    translations: {
      en: {
        consentModal: {
          title: "Cookies & analytics",
          description: "wpml.org uses only our own, first-party analytics — no third-party trackers, and your data is never shared. You decide whether we may set one analytics cookie. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts. You can change your choice any time."
        },
        consentNotice: {
          description: "We'd like to set one first-party analytics cookie to understand how this site is used. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts.",
          learnMore: "Customize"
        },
        acceptAll: "Accept all",
        acceptSelected: "Accept selected",
        decline: "Decline",
        ok: "Accept",
        purposes: { analytics: "Analytics" },
        "otgs-analytics": { description: "WPML's own visitor analytics (first-party). Sets one cookie so we can understand how visits flow across pages. If you decline, only anonymous, cookie-free page counts remain." },
        privacyPolicyUrl: "/documentation/privacy-policy-and-gdpr-compliance/"
      }
    },
    services: [
      {
        name: "otgs-analytics",
        title: "WPML visitor analytics",
        purposes: ["analytics"],
        required: false,
        default: false,
        /* NO cookies regex on purpose (MSG-cmo-0009 single-ownership ruling):
           pv.js (v1.9) owns the _otgs_vid and _otgs_gclick lifecycle — Klaro purging it here
           deleted the full-mode cookie for geo-exempt visitors the moment
           its manager initialized (default-deny). Klaro stores choices;
           it never enforces the tracker's cookie. */
        cookies: []
      }
    ]
  };
  /* Init gate (MSG-cmo-0011). Three outcomes:
       - a stored `klaro` cookie exists (explicit prior choice) -> setup(), which
         renders nothing while the stored map covers the service list, but keeps
         the config-drift re-prompt working for choice-holders;
       - no stored choice -> the cached /consent-policy answer (sessionStorage
         key otgs_cp, SHARED with pv.js: "1"=required, "0"=not) decides;
       - required -> setup() (banner shows); not required -> DO NOT INIT AT ALL.
     Any error fails SAFE to required. pv.js resolves its own tier independently,
     so skipping init never costs us the page counts. Deferred consent.js has
     run by DOMContentLoaded. */
  function consentRequired() {
    try {
      var c = sessionStorage.getItem("otgs_cp");
      if (c !== null) return Promise.resolve(c === "1");
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!window.fetch) return Promise.resolve(true);
    /* 4 s timeout: a black-holed app (dark production, systemsdev-15920)
       hangs this fetch forever and the banner never shows. Abort = error =
       the fail-SAFE-to-required path below, unchanged. */
    var ctl = window.AbortController ? new AbortController() : null;
    if (ctl) setTimeout(function () { ctl.abort(); }, 4000);
    return fetch("https://app.wpml.org/consent-policy", { credentials: "omit", signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined })
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function (j) {
        if (!j || typeof j.required !== "boolean") return true;
        try { sessionStorage.setItem("otgs_cp", j.required ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}
        return j.required;
      })
      .catch(function () { return true; });
  }
  function initConsent() {
    if (window.klaro) window.klaro.setup(window.otgsConsentConfig);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (/(?:^|;\s*)klaro=/.test(document.cookie)) return initConsent();
    consentRequired().then(function (required) {
      if (required) initConsent();
    });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var data = window.otgsNotFound || {};
  var langs = data.langs || {};
  var root = document.querySelector("[data-nf-root]");
  if (!root) return;

  /* The language is the first segment of the address, when it is one of the
     site's languages; otherwise English. The forum note shows on any old forum
     address, in any language. */
  var parts = (location.pathname || "/").split("/");
  var lang = (parts[1] && langs[parts[1]]) ? parts[1] : "en";
  var L = langs[lang] || {};
  var isForum = /^\/(?:[a-z-]+\/)?forums(?:\/|$)/i.test(location.pathname || "");

  if (lang !== "en") {
    var s = L.strings || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf]").forEach(function (el) {
      var k = el.getAttribute("data-nf");
      if (k && s[k]) el.textContent = s[k];
    });
    var inp = document.querySelector("[data-nf-placeholder]");
    if (inp && s.search_placeholder) inp.setAttribute("placeholder", s.search_placeholder);
    var h1 = document.querySelector("h1.page-title");
    if (h1 && s.title) { h1.textContent = s.title; document.title = s.title; }
    var lead = document.querySelector("header.page-header .lead");
    if (lead && s.lead) lead.textContent = s.lead;
    var links = L.links || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf-link]").forEach(function (a) {
      var k = a.getAttribute("data-nf-link");
      if (links[k]) a.setAttribute("href", links[k]);
    });
    /* The tracker reads document.documentElement.lang; a missing Spanish page
       is a Spanish page view. */
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("lang", lang);
    if (L.rtl) document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
  }
  if (isForum) {
    var note = document.querySelector("[data-nf-forum]");
    if (note) note.hidden = false;
  }

  /* The search field hands its query to the site's own search modal, the same
     one the header icon opens, so results and their links are the site's. */
  var form = document.querySelector("[data-nf-form]");
  var q = document.getElementById("nf-q");
  form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var opener = document.querySelector("[data-gs-open]");
    var target = document.querySelector("[data-gs-input]");
    if (!opener || !target) return;
    opener.click();
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      target.value = q.value;
      target.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    }, 60);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  /* Exposed as otgsConsentConfig, NEVER as window.klaroConfig (MSG-cmo-0011):
     Klaro AUTO-RUNS setup() the moment it detects window.klaroConfig, which
     showed the banner even where D11 says it must not. The `noAutoLoad` flag
     does not help — it is only honoured on the branch where Klaro fetches its
     own config, and setting it makes an explicit setup() a no-op instead.
     So: no auto-detected global, and the gate below inits explicitly.
     Neutral name also keeps "klaro" out of the source (EasyList posture). */
  window.otgsConsentConfig = {
    version: 1,
    elementID: "klaro",
    styling: { theme: ["right", "bottom", "light"] },
    /* D11 geo gate (MSG-cmo-0008/0011, CONSENT-SYNC.md §0): Klaro is inited
       only where the law requires consent, or where the visitor already has a
       stored choice. The footer "Cookie Settings" button lazy-inits on demand,
       so it works from the never-inited state too — it passes the modal flag,
       because a bare show() from that state renders the NOTICE instead of the
       settings modal. */
    cookieExpiresAfterDays: 365,
    /* one consent across wpml.org + app.wpml.org (MSG-cmo-0057 §4): the app reads this
       cookie to pick the tracker mode. Local preview hosts fall back to host-only. */
    cookieDomain: location.hostname.endsWith("wpml.org") ? ".wpml.org" : undefined,
    default: false,
    mustConsent: false,
    acceptAll: true,
    hideDeclineAll: false,
    lang: "en",
    translations: {
      en: {
        consentModal: {
          title: "Cookies & analytics",
          description: "wpml.org uses only our own, first-party analytics — no third-party trackers, and your data is never shared. You decide whether we may set one analytics cookie. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts. You can change your choice any time."
        },
        consentNotice: {
          description: "We'd like to set one first-party analytics cookie to understand how this site is used. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts.",
          learnMore: "Customize"
        },
        acceptAll: "Accept all",
        acceptSelected: "Accept selected",
        decline: "Decline",
        ok: "Accept",
        purposes: { analytics: "Analytics" },
        "otgs-analytics": { description: "WPML's own visitor analytics (first-party). Sets one cookie so we can understand how visits flow across pages. If you decline, only anonymous, cookie-free page counts remain." },
        privacyPolicyUrl: "/documentation/privacy-policy-and-gdpr-compliance/"
      }
    },
    services: [
      {
        name: "otgs-analytics",
        title: "WPML visitor analytics",
        purposes: ["analytics"],
        required: false,
        default: false,
        /* NO cookies regex on purpose (MSG-cmo-0009 single-ownership ruling):
           pv.js (v1.9) owns the _otgs_vid and _otgs_gclick lifecycle — Klaro purging it here
           deleted the full-mode cookie for geo-exempt visitors the moment
           its manager initialized (default-deny). Klaro stores choices;
           it never enforces the tracker's cookie. */
        cookies: []
      }
    ]
  };
  /* Init gate (MSG-cmo-0011). Three outcomes:
       - a stored `klaro` cookie exists (explicit prior choice) -> setup(), which
         renders nothing while the stored map covers the service list, but keeps
         the config-drift re-prompt working for choice-holders;
       - no stored choice -> the cached /consent-policy answer (sessionStorage
         key otgs_cp, SHARED with pv.js: "1"=required, "0"=not) decides;
       - required -> setup() (banner shows); not required -> DO NOT INIT AT ALL.
     Any error fails SAFE to required. pv.js resolves its own tier independently,
     so skipping init never costs us the page counts. Deferred consent.js has
     run by DOMContentLoaded. */
  function consentRequired() {
    try {
      var c = sessionStorage.getItem("otgs_cp");
      if (c !== null) return Promise.resolve(c === "1");
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!window.fetch) return Promise.resolve(true);
    /* 4 s timeout: a black-holed app (dark production, systemsdev-15920)
       hangs this fetch forever and the banner never shows. Abort = error =
       the fail-SAFE-to-required path below, unchanged. */
    var ctl = window.AbortController ? new AbortController() : null;
    if (ctl) setTimeout(function () { ctl.abort(); }, 4000);
    return fetch("https://app.wpml.org/consent-policy", { credentials: "omit", signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined })
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function (j) {
        if (!j || typeof j.required !== "boolean") return true;
        try { sessionStorage.setItem("otgs_cp", j.required ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}
        return j.required;
      })
      .catch(function () { return true; });
  }
  function initConsent() {
    if (window.klaro) window.klaro.setup(window.otgsConsentConfig);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (/(?:^|;\s*)klaro=/.test(document.cookie)) return initConsent();
    consentRequired().then(function (required) {
      if (required) initConsent();
    });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var data = window.otgsNotFound || {};
  var langs = data.langs || {};
  var root = document.querySelector("[data-nf-root]");
  if (!root) return;

  /* The language is the first segment of the address, when it is one of the
     site's languages; otherwise English. The forum note shows on any old forum
     address, in any language. */
  var parts = (location.pathname || "/").split("/");
  var lang = (parts[1] && langs[parts[1]]) ? parts[1] : "en";
  var L = langs[lang] || {};
  var isForum = /^\/(?:[a-z-]+\/)?forums(?:\/|$)/i.test(location.pathname || "");

  if (lang !== "en") {
    var s = L.strings || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf]").forEach(function (el) {
      var k = el.getAttribute("data-nf");
      if (k && s[k]) el.textContent = s[k];
    });
    var inp = document.querySelector("[data-nf-placeholder]");
    if (inp && s.search_placeholder) inp.setAttribute("placeholder", s.search_placeholder);
    var h1 = document.querySelector("h1.page-title");
    if (h1 && s.title) { h1.textContent = s.title; document.title = s.title; }
    var lead = document.querySelector("header.page-header .lead");
    if (lead && s.lead) lead.textContent = s.lead;
    var links = L.links || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf-link]").forEach(function (a) {
      var k = a.getAttribute("data-nf-link");
      if (links[k]) a.setAttribute("href", links[k]);
    });
    /* The tracker reads document.documentElement.lang; a missing Spanish page
       is a Spanish page view. */
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("lang", lang);
    if (L.rtl) document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
  }
  if (isForum) {
    var note = document.querySelector("[data-nf-forum]");
    if (note) note.hidden = false;
  }

  /* The search field hands its query to the site's own search modal, the same
     one the header icon opens, so results and their links are the site's. */
  var form = document.querySelector("[data-nf-form]");
  var q = document.getElementById("nf-q");
  form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var opener = document.querySelector("[data-gs-open]");
    var target = document.querySelector("[data-gs-input]");
    if (!opener || !target) return;
    opener.click();
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      target.value = q.value;
      target.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    }, 60);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  /* Exposed as otgsConsentConfig, NEVER as window.klaroConfig (MSG-cmo-0011):
     Klaro AUTO-RUNS setup() the moment it detects window.klaroConfig, which
     showed the banner even where D11 says it must not. The `noAutoLoad` flag
     does not help — it is only honoured on the branch where Klaro fetches its
     own config, and setting it makes an explicit setup() a no-op instead.
     So: no auto-detected global, and the gate below inits explicitly.
     Neutral name also keeps "klaro" out of the source (EasyList posture). */
  window.otgsConsentConfig = {
    version: 1,
    elementID: "klaro",
    styling: { theme: ["right", "bottom", "light"] },
    /* D11 geo gate (MSG-cmo-0008/0011, CONSENT-SYNC.md §0): Klaro is inited
       only where the law requires consent, or where the visitor already has a
       stored choice. The footer "Cookie Settings" button lazy-inits on demand,
       so it works from the never-inited state too — it passes the modal flag,
       because a bare show() from that state renders the NOTICE instead of the
       settings modal. */
    cookieExpiresAfterDays: 365,
    /* one consent across wpml.org + app.wpml.org (MSG-cmo-0057 §4): the app reads this
       cookie to pick the tracker mode. Local preview hosts fall back to host-only. */
    cookieDomain: location.hostname.endsWith("wpml.org") ? ".wpml.org" : undefined,
    default: false,
    mustConsent: false,
    acceptAll: true,
    hideDeclineAll: false,
    lang: "en",
    translations: {
      en: {
        consentModal: {
          title: "Cookies & analytics",
          description: "wpml.org uses only our own, first-party analytics — no third-party trackers, and your data is never shared. You decide whether we may set one analytics cookie. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts. You can change your choice any time."
        },
        consentNotice: {
          description: "We'd like to set one first-party analytics cookie to understand how this site is used. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts.",
          learnMore: "Customize"
        },
        acceptAll: "Accept all",
        acceptSelected: "Accept selected",
        decline: "Decline",
        ok: "Accept",
        purposes: { analytics: "Analytics" },
        "otgs-analytics": { description: "WPML's own visitor analytics (first-party). Sets one cookie so we can understand how visits flow across pages. If you decline, only anonymous, cookie-free page counts remain." },
        privacyPolicyUrl: "/documentation/privacy-policy-and-gdpr-compliance/"
      }
    },
    services: [
      {
        name: "otgs-analytics",
        title: "WPML visitor analytics",
        purposes: ["analytics"],
        required: false,
        default: false,
        /* NO cookies regex on purpose (MSG-cmo-0009 single-ownership ruling):
           pv.js (v1.9) owns the _otgs_vid and _otgs_gclick lifecycle — Klaro purging it here
           deleted the full-mode cookie for geo-exempt visitors the moment
           its manager initialized (default-deny). Klaro stores choices;
           it never enforces the tracker's cookie. */
        cookies: []
      }
    ]
  };
  /* Init gate (MSG-cmo-0011). Three outcomes:
       - a stored `klaro` cookie exists (explicit prior choice) -> setup(), which
         renders nothing while the stored map covers the service list, but keeps
         the config-drift re-prompt working for choice-holders;
       - no stored choice -> the cached /consent-policy answer (sessionStorage
         key otgs_cp, SHARED with pv.js: "1"=required, "0"=not) decides;
       - required -> setup() (banner shows); not required -> DO NOT INIT AT ALL.
     Any error fails SAFE to required. pv.js resolves its own tier independently,
     so skipping init never costs us the page counts. Deferred consent.js has
     run by DOMContentLoaded. */
  function consentRequired() {
    try {
      var c = sessionStorage.getItem("otgs_cp");
      if (c !== null) return Promise.resolve(c === "1");
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!window.fetch) return Promise.resolve(true);
    /* 4 s timeout: a black-holed app (dark production, systemsdev-15920)
       hangs this fetch forever and the banner never shows. Abort = error =
       the fail-SAFE-to-required path below, unchanged. */
    var ctl = window.AbortController ? new AbortController() : null;
    if (ctl) setTimeout(function () { ctl.abort(); }, 4000);
    return fetch("https://app.wpml.org/consent-policy", { credentials: "omit", signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined })
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function (j) {
        if (!j || typeof j.required !== "boolean") return true;
        try { sessionStorage.setItem("otgs_cp", j.required ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}
        return j.required;
      })
      .catch(function () { return true; });
  }
  function initConsent() {
    if (window.klaro) window.klaro.setup(window.otgsConsentConfig);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (/(?:^|;\s*)klaro=/.test(document.cookie)) return initConsent();
    consentRequired().then(function (required) {
      if (required) initConsent();
    });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  /* Exposed as otgsConsentConfig, NEVER as window.klaroConfig (MSG-cmo-0011):
     Klaro AUTO-RUNS setup() the moment it detects window.klaroConfig, which
     showed the banner even where D11 says it must not. The `noAutoLoad` flag
     does not help — it is only honoured on the branch where Klaro fetches its
     own config, and setting it makes an explicit setup() a no-op instead.
     So: no auto-detected global, and the gate below inits explicitly.
     Neutral name also keeps "klaro" out of the source (EasyList posture). */
  window.otgsConsentConfig = {
    version: 1,
    elementID: "klaro",
    styling: { theme: ["right", "bottom", "light"] },
    /* D11 geo gate (MSG-cmo-0008/0011, CONSENT-SYNC.md §0): Klaro is inited
       only where the law requires consent, or where the visitor already has a
       stored choice. The footer "Cookie Settings" button lazy-inits on demand,
       so it works from the never-inited state too — it passes the modal flag,
       because a bare show() from that state renders the NOTICE instead of the
       settings modal. */
    cookieExpiresAfterDays: 365,
    /* one consent across wpml.org + app.wpml.org (MSG-cmo-0057 §4): the app reads this
       cookie to pick the tracker mode. Local preview hosts fall back to host-only. */
    cookieDomain: location.hostname.endsWith("wpml.org") ? ".wpml.org" : undefined,
    default: false,
    mustConsent: false,
    acceptAll: true,
    hideDeclineAll: false,
    lang: "en",
    translations: {
      en: {
        consentModal: {
          title: "Cookies & analytics",
          description: "wpml.org uses only our own, first-party analytics — no third-party trackers, and your data is never shared. You decide whether we may set one analytics cookie. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts. You can change your choice any time."
        },
        consentNotice: {
          description: "We'd like to set one first-party analytics cookie to understand how this site is used. If you decline, we only keep anonymous, cookie-free page counts.",
          learnMore: "Customize"
        },
        acceptAll: "Accept all",
        acceptSelected: "Accept selected",
        decline: "Decline",
        ok: "Accept",
        purposes: { analytics: "Analytics" },
        "otgs-analytics": { description: "WPML's own visitor analytics (first-party). Sets one cookie so we can understand how visits flow across pages. If you decline, only anonymous, cookie-free page counts remain." },
        privacyPolicyUrl: "/documentation/privacy-policy-and-gdpr-compliance/"
      }
    },
    services: [
      {
        name: "otgs-analytics",
        title: "WPML visitor analytics",
        purposes: ["analytics"],
        required: false,
        default: false,
        /* NO cookies regex on purpose (MSG-cmo-0009 single-ownership ruling):
           pv.js (v1.9) owns the _otgs_vid and _otgs_gclick lifecycle — Klaro purging it here
           deleted the full-mode cookie for geo-exempt visitors the moment
           its manager initialized (default-deny). Klaro stores choices;
           it never enforces the tracker's cookie. */
        cookies: []
      }
    ]
  };
  /* Init gate (MSG-cmo-0011). Three outcomes:
       - a stored `klaro` cookie exists (explicit prior choice) -> setup(), which
         renders nothing while the stored map covers the service list, but keeps
         the config-drift re-prompt working for choice-holders;
       - no stored choice -> the cached /consent-policy answer (sessionStorage
         key otgs_cp, SHARED with pv.js: "1"=required, "0"=not) decides;
       - required -> setup() (banner shows); not required -> DO NOT INIT AT ALL.
     Any error fails SAFE to required. pv.js resolves its own tier independently,
     so skipping init never costs us the page counts. Deferred consent.js has
     run by DOMContentLoaded. */
  function consentRequired() {
    try {
      var c = sessionStorage.getItem("otgs_cp");
      if (c !== null) return Promise.resolve(c === "1");
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!window.fetch) return Promise.resolve(true);
    /* 4 s timeout: a black-holed app (dark production, systemsdev-15920)
       hangs this fetch forever and the banner never shows. Abort = error =
       the fail-SAFE-to-required path below, unchanged. */
    var ctl = window.AbortController ? new AbortController() : null;
    if (ctl) setTimeout(function () { ctl.abort(); }, 4000);
    return fetch("https://app.wpml.org/consent-policy", { credentials: "omit", signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined })
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function (j) {
        if (!j || typeof j.required !== "boolean") return true;
        try { sessionStorage.setItem("otgs_cp", j.required ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}
        return j.required;
      })
      .catch(function () { return true; });
  }
  function initConsent() {
    if (window.klaro) window.klaro.setup(window.otgsConsentConfig);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (/(?:^|;\s*)klaro=/.test(document.cookie)) return initConsent();
    consentRequired().then(function (required) {
      if (required) initConsent();
    });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var data = window.otgsNotFound || {};
  var langs = data.langs || {};
  var root = document.querySelector("[data-nf-root]");
  if (!root) return;

  /* The language is the first segment of the address, when it is one of the
     site's languages; otherwise English. The forum note shows on any old forum
     address, in any language. */
  var parts = (location.pathname || "/").split("/");
  var lang = (parts[1] && langs[parts[1]]) ? parts[1] : "en";
  var L = langs[lang] || {};
  var isForum = /^\/(?:[a-z-]+\/)?forums(?:\/|$)/i.test(location.pathname || "");

  if (lang !== "en") {
    var s = L.strings || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf]").forEach(function (el) {
      var k = el.getAttribute("data-nf");
      if (k && s[k]) el.textContent = s[k];
    });
    var inp = document.querySelector("[data-nf-placeholder]");
    if (inp && s.search_placeholder) inp.setAttribute("placeholder", s.search_placeholder);
    var h1 = document.querySelector("h1.page-title");
    if (h1 && s.title) { h1.textContent = s.title; document.title = s.title; }
    var lead = document.querySelector("header.page-header .lead");
    if (lead && s.lead) lead.textContent = s.lead;
    var links = L.links || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf-link]").forEach(function (a) {
      var k = a.getAttribute("data-nf-link");
      if (links[k]) a.setAttribute("href", links[k]);
    });
    /* The tracker reads document.documentElement.lang; a missing Spanish page
       is a Spanish page view. */
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("lang", lang);
    if (L.rtl) document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
  }
  if (isForum) {
    var note = document.querySelector("[data-nf-forum]");
    if (note) note.hidden = false;
  }

  /* The search field hands its query to the site's own search modal, the same
     one the header icon opens, so results and their links are the site's. */
  var form = document.querySelector("[data-nf-form]");
  var q = document.getElementById("nf-q");
  form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var opener = document.querySelector("[data-gs-open]");
    var target = document.querySelector("[data-gs-input]");
    if (!opener || !target) return;
    opener.click();
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      target.value = q.value;
      target.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    }, 60);
  });
})();
</script>

     own config, and setting it makes an explicit setup() a no-op instead.

     Neutral name also keeps "klaro" out of the source (EasyList posture). */

    version: 1,

    styling: { theme: ["right", "bottom", "light"] },
    /* D11 geo gate (MSG-cmo-0008/0011, CONSENT-SYNC.md §0): Klaro is inited

       stored choice. The footer "Cookie Settings" button lazy-inits on demand,
       so it works from the never-inited state too — it passes the modal flag,
       because a bare show() from that state renders the NOTICE instead of the
       settings modal. */
    cookieExpiresAfterDays: 365,
    /* one consent across wpml.org + app.wpml.org (MSG-cmo-0057 §4): the app reads this

       - a stored `klaro` cookie exists (explicit prior choice) -> setup(), which
         renders nothing while the stored map covers the service list, but keeps
         the config-drift re-prompt working for choice-holders;
       - no stored choice -> the cached /consent-policy answer (sessionStorage
         key otgs_cp, SHARED with pv.js: "1"=required, "0"=not) decides;
       - required -> setup() (banner shows); not required -> DO NOT INIT AT ALL.
     Any error fails SAFE to required. pv.js resolves its own tier independently,
     so skipping init never costs us the page counts. Deferred consent.js has
     run by DOMContentLoaded. */
  function consentRequired() {
    try {
      var c = sessionStorage.getItem("otgs_cp");
      if (c !== null) return Promise.resolve(c === "1");

       the fail-SAFE-to-required path below, unchanged. */

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var data = window.otgsNotFound || {};
  var langs = data.langs || {};
  var root = document.querySelector("[data-nf-root]");
  if (!root) return;

  /* The language is the first segment of the address, when it is one of the
     site's languages; otherwise English. The forum note shows on any old forum
     address, in any language. */
  var parts = (location.pathname || "/").split("/");
  var lang = (parts[1] && langs[parts[1]]) ? parts[1] : "en";
  var L = langs[lang] || {};
  var isForum = /^\/(?:[a-z-]+\/)?forums(?:\/|$)/i.test(location.pathname || "");

  if (lang !== "en") {
    var s = L.strings || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf]").forEach(function (el) {
      var k = el.getAttribute("data-nf");
      if (k && s[k]) el.textContent = s[k];
    });
    var inp = document.querySelector("[data-nf-placeholder]");
    if (inp && s.search_placeholder) inp.setAttribute("placeholder", s.search_placeholder);
    var h1 = document.querySelector("h1.page-title");
    if (h1 && s.title) { h1.textContent = s.title; document.title = s.title; }
    var lead = document.querySelector("header.page-header .lead");
    if (lead && s.lead) lead.textContent = s.lead;
    var links = L.links || {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-nf-link]").forEach(function (a) {
      var k = a.getAttribute("data-nf-link");
      if (links[k]) a.setAttribute("href", links[k]);
    });
    /* The tracker reads document.documentElement.lang; a missing Spanish page
       is a Spanish page view. */
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("lang", lang);
    if (L.rtl) document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
  }
  if (isForum) {
    var note = document.querySelector("[data-nf-forum]");
    if (note) note.hidden = false;
  }

  /* The search field hands its query to the site's own search modal, the same
     one the header icon opens, so results and their links are the site's. */
  var form = document.querySelector("[data-nf-form]");
  var q = document.getElementById("nf-q");
  form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var opener = document.querySelector("[data-gs-open]");
    var target = document.querySelector("[data-gs-input]");
    if (!opener || !target) return;
    opener.click();
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      target.value = q.value;
      target.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    }, 60);
  });
})();
</script>
